title: Filter-Visit Deduction on Cancelled Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Plans
content:
# Filter-Visit Deduction

A Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans includes cabin and engine air filters at visits 6 and 12. When the plan is cancelled, the filter-visit deduction reads the plan's net visits used: visits redeemed less visits reinstated, as the plan ledger shows them.

| Net visits used | Filter-visit deduction (USD) |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 90.00 |
| 6 or more, but fewer than 12 | 45.00 |
| Fewer than 6 | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical ledgers)
| Redeemed | Reinstated | Net used | Deduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0 | 6 | 45.00 |
| 6 | 1 | 5 | nothing |
| 11 | 0 | 11 | 45.00 |
| 12 | 0 | 12 | 90.00 |

A redemption that has been reinstated does not count toward the net visits used.
